Subject: SKU carve strategy for APAC pilot & co-sell handshake

Marissa / Jonas —

Quick note to start the thread. Acme is ready to pilot in APAC but they want a narrow marketplace SKU footprint for the first 90 days to simplify procurement and co-sell enablement. High-level asks from Acme:

- Single entry SKU per cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) for the pilot with region-level gating (APAC-main: ap-southeast-1, ap-northeast-1).
- A 90-day discounted trial SKU that maps to our Starter bundle (burstable dedicated + hosted fallback).
- Co-sell credits and an option to convert to reserved Dedicated within 60 days of hitting thresholds.

I put a first-pass SKU carve in the attached sku-matrix-apac-v1.xlsx — focused on low-friction listing names and minimal variants. Need your thoughts:

1) Do we want a single SKU per cloud or an entry SKU + a 1-click upgrade SKU? I'm leaning single SKU for listing simplicity and let the Console handle upgrade flow.
2) For co-sell handshake, we should confirm marketplace listing support for an "enable co-sell" flag and a partner-facing collateral bundle. Jonas — can you confirm what co-sell metadata we can populate on each marketplace listing?

Goal: finalize the carve and the doc to share with Acme by Monday (2026-11-09).

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | Head of Marketplace GTM | Redwood Inference

Vivek —

Thanks, this looks like the right starting point. A few practical notes after skimming the matrix:

- Keep it one SKU per cloud for the pilot. Marketplace UI/approval times spike when we introduce multiple SKUs. We can expose an "Upgrade to Dedicated" button in product pages instead.
- Naming: use "Redwood Inference — Starter (APAC)" exact phrase for all three clouds; that helps sales ops mapping.
- Pricing: provide a 45% pilot discount for 90 days instead of a flat trial SKU; less churn on approvals from cloud procurement.
- Co-sell metadata: Jonas, we need these fields added to the listing: Partner POC, Deal ID (ACME-PRD-4871), Co-sell enablement note, and Link to Solution Brief.

I'll update the SKU sheet with the naming and discount column and attach a short Acme MAU estimate (acme-mau-estimates.pdf) so we can justify crediting posture.

If that's all good I'll put together a single slide for the co-sell collateral we hand to the partner team.

—Marissa

Forwarding with ops notes — I greenlight the one-SKU approach. Operational constraints and answers below; sending to AWS marketplace ops and copying the Acme contact in the next message.

Operational notes (quick):
- Marketplace metadata: AWS supports custom attributes we can set via listing API; include partner_poc, deal_id, co_sell_enabled=true.
- Regions: for APAC pilot, request listing region scope: ap-southeast-1 and ap-northeast-1 only. Multi-region entitlements will be set to those two.
- SKU packaging: use "Instance-based metered + hosted fallback" plan. We should include a single SKU price and a SKU attribute that maps to our Console "Upgrade to Dedicated" flow.
- Timeline: AWS listings will take ~7 business days after submission for review; plan submission Friday 2026-11-12 to hit production before Dec.

Sending draft to Acme and AWS marketplace ops now. Attaching the draft term sheet (draft-mpa-term-sheet.docx) for Acme review; please add legal-savvy comments before I hit send.

—Jonas
